name: secret-scan-precommit
summary: A git pre-commit check that refuses a commit adding a key, a password, or a secrets file, and never prints the value.
git_hook: pre-commit, wired into one repo at a time by install-hook.sh (never into settings.json)

env.SECRET_SCAN_VALUE_FILES: optional: colon-separated notes files whose key-like values must never be committed
env.SECRET_SCAN_ENV_ROOTS: optional: colon-separated folders whose .env files are read for secret values, default the repo being committed
env.SECRET_SCAN_ALLOW_PATHS: optional: colon-separated repo paths that hold made-up secret-shaped fixtures on purpose
